text.html: Ceremonial Matcha from Uji
text.text: Ceremonial Matcha from Uji

text.html: First-harvest stone-ground ceremonial matcha from Kyoto's most respected growing region. Deep umami, naturally sweet, no bitterness. The benchmark for Japanese ceremonial-grade matcha.

text.html:
ASA Matcha is available exclusively to Pure Matcha Partners clients. If you're already working with us, you can add ASA Matcha products to your order directly through the Pure Matcha Partners client portal.

‍Whether you're a café looking for a retail product to recommend to customers, a concept store expanding your wellness offer, or a retailer looking for a brand-ready premium matcha — ASA Matcha is available to you through your existing PMP relationship.

No separate supplier relationship needed. Same quality, same service, same team.

text.html:
ASA Matcha is available to consumers across Europe through:

- Direct to consumer, asa-matcha.com
- De Bijenkorf,  the Netherlands' leading premium department store
- Premium concept stores and cafés across Europe
‍

Why This Partnership Exists
‍Pure Matcha Partners and ASA Matcha share the same supply chain and the same sourcing standards. When B2B clients ask what consumer brand to recommend to their customers, ASA Matcha is the answer we stand behind.It's the same quality, in a format built for the end consumer.
